description: This file defines the interface ISubscriptionHandler for handling subscription mechanisms within the Kuksa Val project. It declares methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, publishing, and managing server threads, which are essential for the subscription handling component of the system.

classes.name: ISubscriptionHandler
classes.description: An interface class defining subscription-related operations in the Kuksa Val system.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a new subscription for a given channel, database, path, and attribute.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an existing subscription identified by its SubscriptionId.

methods.name: unsubscribeAll
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions associated with a given KuksaChannel.

methods.name: publishForVSSPath
methods.description: Publishes a value to all subscribers on a specific VSS path with associated datatype and attribute.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the server instance managing subscriptions.

methods.name: startThread
methods.description: Starts the internal thread managing subscription operations.

methods.name: stopThread
methods.description: Stops the internal thread managing subscription operations.

methods.name: isThreadRunning
methods.description: Checks if the internal thread managing subscriptions is currently running.

methods.name: subThreadRunner
methods.description: Function to run inside the subscription handler thread.

methods.name: addPublisher
methods.description: Adds a publisher instance to the subscription handler.
